def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    lady_patches = image_patch.find("lady")
    glasses_patches = image_patch.find("glasses")
    
    if not lady_patches or not glasses_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    lady_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in lady_patches]
    glasses_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in glasses_patches]
    
    min_distance = float('inf')
    closest_lady = None
    closest_glasses = None
    
    for lady_center in lady_centers:
        for glasses_center in glasses_centers:
            distance = abs(lady_center - glasses_center)
            if distance < min_distance:
                min_distance = distance
                closest_lady = lady_patches[lady_centers.index(lady_center)]

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    skateboard_patches = image_patch.find("skateboard")
    
    if not person_patches or not skateboard_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    skateboard_centers = [(s.left + s.right) / 2 for s in skateboard_patches]
    
    closest_person = min(person_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - min(skateboard_centers)))
    closest_skateboard = min(skateboard_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - closest_person))
    
    person_idx = person_centers.index(closest_person)
    skateboard_idx = skateboard_centers.index(closest_skateboard)
    
    person_patch = person_patches[person_idx]
    skateboard_patch = skateboard_patches[skateboard_idx]
    
    if person_patch.overlaps_with(*skateboard_patch.bbox()):
        return person_patch
    
    return person_patch

    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    fence_patches = image_patch.find("fence")

    if not man_patches or not fence_patches:
        return "No man or fence found in the image."

    man_patch = man_patches[0]
    fence_patch = fence_patches[0]

    if man_patch.overlaps_with(*fence_patch.left, *fence_patch.lower, *fence_patch.right, *fence_patch.upper):
        return "The man is inside the fence."
    
    if man_patch.left > fence_patch.right or man_patch.right < fence_patch.left or \
       man_patch.lower > fence_patch.upper or man_patch.upper < fence_patch.lower:
        return "The man is outside the fence."

    return "The man is behind the fence."

    # Sort the man patches by their distance to the nearest fence
    man_patches.sort(key=lambda man: min(distance(man, fence) for fence in fence_patches))

    closest_man_patch = man_patches[0]

    boy_patches = image_patch.find("boy")
    if not boy_patches:

    # Check if the leftmost boy patch is in front of all other boy patches

    # If the leftmost boy patch is not in front, return the patch with the smallest depth
    return depth_order(boy_patches)[0]
